title: M5 stage14: subset generating polynomial character count
scope: Five symbolic subset counting targets; quotient transport and closed binomial evaluation remain separate

spec.name: M5.SubsetCharacter.value_zero
spec.guidance: Unfold value and bitSign; every product factor is one. This auxiliary is local to this independent experiment and does not depend on stage15. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.SubsetCharacter.character_subset_sum
spec.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (U : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), M5.Character.value lam (M5.SubsetCharacter.vectorSum U f) = ∏ s ∈ U, M5.Character.value lam (f s)
spec.guidance: Induct on finite set U. Empty sum uses value_zero; insertion uses Finset.sum_insert, Finset.prod_insert and accepted character_add. This keeps arbitrary vector coincidences and binary cancellations. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.SubsetCharacter.signed_product_expansion
spec.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), M5.SubsetCharacter.signedProduct S (fun s => M5.Character.value lam (f s)) = ∑ U ∈ S.powerset, Polynomial.C (M5.Character.value lam (M5.SubsetCharacter.vectorSum U f)) * (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ U.card
spec.guidance: Unfold signedProduct and apply Finset.prod_one_add to factors C(value lam(f s))*X. For each subset U, distribute the product, use Polynomial.C as a multiplicative map, and the product of constant X factors is X^U.card. Rewrite the product of character values using character_subset_sum. Polynomial identity over integers, including empty S. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.SubsetCharacter.signed_product_coefficient
spec.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), (M5.SubsetCharacter.signedProduct S (fun s => M5.Character.value lam (f s))).coeff k = ∑ U ∈ S.powersetCard k, M5.Character.value lam (M5.SubsetCharacter.vectorSum U f)
spec.guidance: Take coeff k of signed_product_expansion. Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow gives an indicator of U.card=k. Finset.powersetCard_eq_filter and Finset.sum_filter identify the resulting sum. No assumption k≤S.card: the right side is empty and both sides zero when k is too large. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.

spec.name: M5.SubsetCharacter.subset_character_count
spec.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (z : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), (∑ lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector D, M5.Character.value lam z * (M5.SubsetCharacter.signedProduct S (fun s => M5.Character.value lam (f s))).coeff k) = (2 : ℤ) ^ D * (M5.SubsetCharacter.count S k f z : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Rewrite signed_product_coefficient, distribute multiplication and swap finite sums. Combine characters using accepted character_add, then apply character_orthogonality. Pointwise characteristic two proves z+vectorSum U f=0 iff vectorSum U f=z. Filter indicators turn the remaining sum into count. Preserve the 2^D-scaled integer identity and all empty cases; no rational division or binomial evaluation needed here. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact statements.
